quotes: Better than a thousand hollow words is one word that brings peace.||Dhammapada
Talk to yourself the way you would talk to a friend you care about.
A bad day is an event. It is not a verdict on who you are.
Progress counts even when it is small and quiet.
posts.caption:
Peace can start with one kind word, even to yourself. 🌿

Dhammapada, verse 100 (translations vary). General psychology ideas, not medical advice.

quotes: If you realize you have enough, you are truly rich.||Lao Tzu
posts.caption:
Enough is a quiet kind of wealth. 🍃

Lao Tzu, Tao Te Ching ch. 33 (translations vary).

quotes: It is not things that disturb us, but our judgments about them.||Epictetus
Make the habit so small you cannot say no. Then repeat it.
Waiting to feel ready is a trap. Begin, and readiness follows.
Decide the next step in advance, so tired-you does not have to.
posts.caption:
Change the judgment, change the day. 🔥

Epictetus, Enchiridion 5 (translations vary). General psychology ideas, not medical advice.

quotes: He suffers more than necessary who suffers before it is necessary.||Seneca
posts.caption:
Do not rent space to tomorrow's worries. 🌅

Seneca, Letters to Lucilius 98 (translations vary).
